entries.title: Job 3:1
segments: ¶After this, Job opened his mouth and cursed his day.

entries.title: Job 3:2
segments: And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 3:3
segments: Let the day perish in which I was born, and the night that said, There is a man child conceived.

entries.title: Job 3:4
segments: That day--let it be darkness, let not +God care for it from above, neither let light shine upon it:

entries.title: Job 3:5
segments: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it; let clouds dwell upon it; let darkeners of the day terrify it.

entries.title: Job 3:6
segments: That night--let gloom seize upon it; let it not rejoice among the days of the year; let it not come into the number of the months.

entries.title: Job 3:7
segments: Behold, let that night be barren; let no joyful sound come therein;

entries.title: Job 3:8
segments: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to rouse Leviathan;

entries.title: Job 3:9
segments: Let the stars of its twilight be dark; let it wait for light, and have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the dawn:

entries.title: Job 3:10
segments: Because it shut not up the doors of the womb that bore me, and hid not trouble from mine eyes.

entries.title: Job 3:11
segments: ¶Wherefore did I not die from the womb, --come forth from the belly and expire?

entries.title: Job 3:12
segments: Why did the knees meet me? and wherefore the breasts, that I should suck?

entries.title: Job 3:13
segments: For now should I have lain down and been quiet; I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

entries.title: Job 3:14
segments: With kings and counsellors of the earth, who build desolate places for themselves,

entries.title: Job 3:15
segments: Or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

entries.title: Job 3:16
segments: Or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants that have not seen the light.

entries.title: Job 3:17
segments: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the wearied are at rest.

entries.title: Job 3:18
segments: The prisoners together are at ease; they hear not the voice of the taskmaster.

entries.title: Job 3:19
segments: The small and great are there, and the bondman freed from his master.

entries.title: Job 3:20
segments: ¶Wherefore is light given to him that is in trouble, and life to those bitter of soul,

entries.title: Job 3:21
segments: Who long for death, and it [cometh] not, and dig for it more than for hidden treasures;

entries.title: Job 3:22
segments: Who rejoice even exultingly and are glad when they find the grave? --

entries.title: Job 3:23
segments: To the man whose way is hidden, and whom +God hath hedged in?

entries.title: Job 3:24
segments: For my sighing cometh before my bread, and my groanings are poured out like the waters.

entries.title: Job 3:25
segments: For I feared a fear, and it hath come upon me, and that which I dreaded hath come to me.

entries.title: Job 3:26
segments: I was not in safety, neither had I quietness, neither was I at rest, and trouble came.
